items.source: The MongoTemplate class implements the interface MongoOperations. In as much as possible, the methods on MongoOperations are named after methods available on the MongoDB driver Collection object, to make the API familiar to existing MongoDB developers who are used to the driver API. For example, you can find methods such as find, findAndModify, findAndReplace, findOne, insert, remove, save, update, and updateMulti. The design goal was to make it as easy as possible to transition between the use of the base MongoDB driver and MongoOperations. A major difference between the two APIs is that MongoOperations can be passed domain objects instead of Document. Also, MongoOperations has fluent APIs for Query, Criteria, and Update operations instead of populating a Document to specify the parameters for those operations.
items.translation:
`MongoTemplate` 类实现了 `MongoOperations` 接口。  
在尽可能多的情况下，`MongoOperations` 上的方法命名与 MongoDB 驱动程序的 `Collection` 对象上的方法保持一致，以便让熟悉驱动程序 API 的现有 MongoDB 开发者能够轻松上手。  
例如，您可以找到诸如 `find`、`findAndModify`、`findAndReplace`、`findOne`、`insert`、`remove`、`save`、`update` 和 `updateMulti` 等方法。  
设计目标是尽可能简化从基础 MongoDB 驱动程序切换到使用 `MongoOperations` 的过程。  
这两个 API 之间的一个主要区别是，`MongoOperations` 可以传递领域对象，而不是 `Document`。  
此外，`MongoOperations` 为 `Query`、`Criteria` 和 `Update` 操作提供了流式 API，而无需通过填充 `Document` 来指定这些操作的参数。

The entry points (insert(…), find(…), update(…), and others) follow a natural naming schema based on the operation to be run. items.source: You can switch between retrieving a single entity and retrieving multiple entities as a List or a Stream through the terminating methods: first(), one(), all(), or stream().
items.translation: 您可以通过终止方法 `first()`、`one()`、`all()` 或 `stream()`，在检索单个实体与检索多个实体（以 `List` 或 `Stream` 形式）之间进行切换。

items.source: Some of the mappings performed by the MongoExceptionTranslator are com.mongodb.Network to DataAccessResourceFailureException and MongoException error codes 1003, 12001, 12010, 12011, and 12012 to InvalidDataAccessApiUsageException. Look into the implementation for more details on the mapping.
items.translation: `MongoExceptionTranslator` 执行的一些映射将 `com.mongodb.Network` 转换为 `DataAccessResourceFailureException`，并将错误代码 1003、12001、12010、12011 和 12012 从 `MongoException` 转换为 `InvalidDataAccessApiUsageException`。请查看实现以获取更多关于映射的详细信息。

items.source: The mapping between MongoDB documents and domain classes is done by delegating to an implementation of the MongoConverter interface. Spring provides MappingMongoConverter, but you can also write your own converter. While the MappingMongoConverter can use additional metadata to specify the mapping of objects to documents, it can also convert objects that contain no additional metadata by using some conventions for the mapping of IDs and collection names. These conventions, as well as the use of mapping annotations, are explained in the Mapping chapter.
items.translation: MongoDB 文档与领域类之间的映射是通过委托给 `MongoConverter` 接口的一个实现来完成的。Spring 提供了 `MappingMongoConverter`，但您也可以编写自己的转换器。虽然 `MappingMongoConverter` 可以利用额外的元数据来指定对象到文档的映射，但它也可以利用一些关于 ID 和集合名称映射的约定，将不包含额外元数据的对象转换为文档。这些约定以及映射注解的使用在 映射 章节中进行了说明。

items.source: The MongoTemplate and its reactive counterpart class, located in the org.springframework.data.mongodb.core package, is the central class of Spring’s MongoDB support and provides a rich feature set for interacting with the database. The template offers convenience operations to create, update, delete, and query MongoDB documents and provides a mapping between your domain objects and MongoDB documents.
items.translation: MongoTemplate 及其位于 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core 包中的反应式对应类 reactive，是 Spring MongoDB 支持的核心类，为与数据库交互提供了丰富的功能集。 该模板提供了创建、更新、删除和查询 MongoDB 文档的便捷操作，并在您的领域对象与 MongoDB 文档之间提供映射关系。

items.source: MongoTemplate offers many convenience methods to help you easily perform common tasks. However, if you need to directly access the MongoDB driver API, you can use one of several Execute callback methods. The execute callbacks gives you a reference to either a MongoCollection or a MongoDatabase object.
items.translation:
MongoTemplate 提供了许多便捷方法，帮助您轻松完成常见任务。  
然而，如果您需要直接访问 MongoDB 驱动程序 API，可以使用多种 `Execute` 回调方法之一。  
`execute` 回调会为您提供对 `MongoCollection` 或 `MongoDatabase` 对象的引用。

items.source: <T> T execute (Class<?> entityClass, CollectionCallback<T> action): Runs the given CollectionCallback for the entity collection of the specified class.
items.translation: <T> T execute (Class<?> entityClass, CollectionCallback<T> action): 为指定类的实体集合执行给定的 CollectionCallback。

items.source: <T> T execute (String collectionName, CollectionCallback<T> action): Runs the given CollectionCallback on the collection of the given name.
items.translation: <T> T execute (String collectionName, CollectionCallback<T> action): 在指定名称的集合上执行给定的 CollectionCallback。

items.source: <T> T execute (String collectionName, DbCallback<T> action): Runs a DbCallback on the collection of the given name translating any exceptions as necessary.
items.translation: <T> T execute (String collectionName, DbCallback<T> action): 在指定名称的集合上运行 DbCallback，并根据需要转换任何异常。

items.source: <T> T executeInSession (DbCallback<T> action): Runs the given DbCallback within the same connection to the database so as to ensure consistency in a write-heavy environment where you may read the data that you wrote.
items.translation: <T> T executeInSession (DbCallback<T> action): 在同一个数据库连接中执行给定的 DbCallback，以确保在写密集型环境中读取您写入的数据时的一致性。

items.source: Exception Translation can be configured by setting a customized MongoExceptionTranslator on your MongoDatabaseFactory or its reactive variant. You might also want to set the exception translator on the corresponding MongoClientFactoryBean.
items.translation: 异常翻译可以通过在您的 `MongoDatabaseFactory` 或其响应式变体上设置自定义的 `MongoExceptionTranslator` 来配置。 您可能还希望在相应的 `MongoClientFactoryBean` 上设置异常翻译器。

items.source: <T> T execute (DbCallback<T> action): Runs a DbCallback, translating any exceptions as necessary. Spring Data MongoDB provides support for the Aggregation Framework introduced to MongoDB in version 2.2.
items.translation: <T> T execute (DbCallback<T> action): 执行 DbCallback，并根据需要转换任何异常。Spring Data MongoDB 提供了对 MongoDB 在 2.2 版本中引入的聚合框架的支持。

items.translation: 结果可以通过使用 `QueryResultConverter` 进行上下文后处理，该转换器能够同时访问原始结果 `Document` 和已映射的对象，通过调用如下所示的 `map(…)` 方法实现。

items.source: The motivation behind mapping to Spring’s consistent data access exception hierarchy is that you are then able to write portable and descriptive exception handling code without resorting to coding against MongoDB error codes. All of Spring’s data access exceptions are inherited from the root DataAccessException class so that you can be sure to catch all database related exception within a single try-catch block. Note that not all exceptions thrown by the MongoDB driver inherit from the MongoException class. The inner exception and message are preserved so that no information is lost.
items.translation: 将异常映射到 Spring 的统一数据访问异常层次结构背后的动机在于，这样您就能编写可移植且描述清晰的异常处理代码，而无需直接针对 MongoDB 的错误码进行编码。 Spring 的所有数据访问异常都继承自根类DataAccessException，这样您就可以确保在一个 try-catch 块中捕获所有与数据库相关的异常。 请注意，并非由 MongoDB 驱动程序抛出的所有异常都继承自MongoException类。 内部异常和消息均被保留，以确保不丢失任何信息。

items.source: For more information please refer to the CRUD and Query sections of the documentation.
items.translation: 有关更多信息，请参阅文档中的CRUD和查询部分。

items.source: Being the central component when it comes to more low-level interaction with MongoDB MongoTemplate offers a wide range of methods covering needs from collection creation, index creation, and CRUD operations to more advanced functionality, such as Map-Reduce and aggregations. You can find multiple overloads for each method. Most of them cover optional or nullable parts of the API.
items.translation: 作为与 MongoDB 进行更底层交互的核心组件，MongoTemplate 提供了广泛的方法集，涵盖从集合创建、索引建立到 CRUD 操作等基础需求，以及 Map-Reduce 和聚合等高级功能。 每种方法都提供多个重载版本。 其中大多数重载覆盖了 API 的可选或可为 null 的部分。

items.source: The Spring framework provides exception translation for a wide variety of database and mapping technologies. This has traditionally been for JDBC and JPA. The Spring support for MongoDB extends this feature to the MongoDB Database by providing an implementation of the org.springframework.dao.support.PersistenceExceptionTranslator interface.
items.translation: Spring 框架为各种数据库和映射技术提供了异常转换功能。传统上，这一功能主要针对 JDBC 和 JPA。Spring 对 MongoDB 的支持将此项功能扩展到了 MongoDB 数据库，通过提供 org.springframework.dao.support.PersistenceExceptionTranslator 接口的实现来实现。

items.source:
A motivation to customize exception can be MongoDB’s behavior during transactions where some failures (such as write conflicts) can become transient and where a retry could lead to a successful operation.
In such a case, you could wrap exceptions with a specific MongoDB label and apply a different exception translation strategy.
items.translation:
自定义异常的一个动机是 MongoDB 在事务期间的行为：某些失败（例如写冲突）可能是瞬时的，而重试可能导致操作成功。  
在这种情况下，您可以使用特定的 MongoDB 标签包装异常，并应用不同的异常转换策略。

items.source: Using projections allows MongoTemplate to optimize result mapping by limiting the actual response to fields required by the projection target type. This applies as long as the Query itself does not contain any field restriction and the target type is a closed interface or DTO projection.
items.translation: 使用投影可以让 MongoTemplate 通过限制实际响应仅包含投影目标类型所需的字段来优化结果映射。只要 Query 本身不包含任何字段限制，且目标类型为封闭接口或 DTO 投影，此规则即适用。

items.source: The preferred way to reference the operations on MongoTemplate instance is through its interface, MongoOperations.
items.translation: 引用 MongoTemplate 实例上操作的首选方式是通过其接口 MongoOperations。

items.source: Once configured, MongoTemplate is thread-safe and can be reused across multiple instances.
items.translation: 配置完成后，MongoTemplate 是线程安全的，可以在多个实例中重复使用。

items.source: Projections must not be applied to DBRefs.
items.translation: 不能将投影应用于 DBRefs。

items.source: 1 The type used to map fields used in the query to.
items.translation: 1 用于将查询中使用的字段映射到的类型。

items.source: 2 The collection name to use if not defined on the domain type.
items.translation: 2 如果未在域类型中定义，则使用的集合名称。

items.source: 3 Result type if not using the original domain type.
items.translation: 3 不使用原始域类型时的结果类型。
